posts.title: Fabric Accelerator: Metadata-Driven ELT Pattern for Mirrored Databases
posts.description: Microsoft Fabric now offers low-cost, low-latency data replication into OneLake through mirroring, facilitating near real-time analytics without complex ingestion. The Fabric Accelerator 5.0 introduces a OneLake-Native ELT Pattern, eliminating duplicate data and accelerating the creation of reliable data products directly from shared assets while maintaining governance and quality standards.

posts.title: Fabric Accelerator: Deployments Now Fully Automated with Fabric CLI
